metrics.name: Teacher Dominance Ratio
metrics.formula: teacher talk time ÷ total speech time
metrics.explanation: Share of all speech that comes from the teacher.
metrics.interpretation: Lecture-heavy: the teacher dominates the airtime; students get little room to speak.

metrics.name: Student Participation Indicator
metrics.explanation: How frequently students take the floor, normalized by session length.

metrics.name: Interaction Density
metrics.explanation: How often the conversation passes between teacher and students — a proxy for back-and-forth dialogue.
metrics.interpretation: Monologue-style: long uninterrupted stretches by one speaker.

metrics.name: Question–Response Rate
metrics.formula: teacher questions answered by a student within 5 s ÷ total teacher questions
metrics.explanation: How many of the teacher's questions actually draw a student response.
metrics.interpretation: Questions largely go unanswered — they may be rhetorical or pacing may be too fast.

summary: In this 68-minute session, the teacher spoke for 97% of the speech time and students for 3%. Students took the floor 24 times, and the conversation switched between teacher and students 48 times. The teacher asked 21 questions, of which 4 drew a student response. About 560 s of the session was silent (longest pause 300 s). Lecture-heavy: the teacher dominates the airtime; students get little room to speak. Monologue-style: long uninterrupted stretches by one speaker.
